entries.mechanism: eitc_earned_income divergence from the partnership/S-corp earned-income input composition that PE-US #8614 (merged 2026-06-14) split and PE 1.729.0 predates. Axiom includes partnership net earnings from self-employment (26 USC 32(c)(2)(A)/1402(a): gross less one-half SE tax) and excludes the S-corp distributive share. Population: 16,660 rows, 10,008 axiom>PE (partnership) and 6,652 axiom<PE (S-corp) — both halves of the same #8614 split. Representative partnership unit ecps-tax_unit_154343 ($126,692 partnership, no other earnings): Axiom eitc_earned_income 117,741.43 vs PE 0.00.

Bracket-boundary rounding between the two engines' rate applications. Verified across all 2,118 rows: |diff| <= $5.83, max relative diff 4.4e-4, both signs. Representative ecps-tax_unit_154369: Axiom 2,789,654.17 vs PE 2,789,660.00, a $5.83 difference on a $2.79M base.

adjusted_net_capital_gain float noise. Verified across all 8 rows: |diff| <= $3.25 on values up to $8.37M (max relative diff 5.0e-7). Representative ecps-tax_unit_161790: Axiom 6,471,728.75 vs PE 6,471,732.00.

26 USC 24(b) phaseout: the credit reduces by $50 per $1,000 (or fraction) of AGI over the threshold. All 5 rows are exactly +$50 = one $1,000 excess-AGI increment x 5%, a difference of one increment in how each engine rounds excess AGI up to the next $1,000. Representative ecps-tax_unit_154297: Axiom 13,929,800 vs PE 13,929,750.
